terms.posture: Clean-room separation of codebase and third-party incident logs.
terms.raw_data_policy: No redistribution of third-party raw logs in git repository. Offline reproduction is achieved via clean-room download recipe (python -m ebe.cli download) verifying SHA256SUMS against the official publisher mirror.
terms.maintainer_outreach: Clarification questions drafted in sources/maintainer_questions.md for optional formal license confirmation. Research proceeds under defensible fair-use analysis of publicly disclosed security incident records.
